name: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B
license: OpenMDW License 1.1 (base Gemma 4 E4B under Apache-2.0)
archDisplay: Gemma-4-E4B architecture (8B total, 4B effective parameters), post-trained by NVIDIA from Gemma-4-E4B-it with multi-environment GRPO RL; 64K-token context; text in, text out; Q4_K_M 4GB release with BF16 reference weights and a DFlash speculative-decoding drafter
note: Second model in NVIDIA's edge-focused Bolt line, released Oct 23, 2026 on Hugging Face and build.nvidia.com as announced with Bolt 74B-A9B on Oct 15: a Gemma-4-E4B post-trained by NVIDIA for fast local voice and device assistants, personas and embedded interfaces, with stronger multi-turn tool use, instruction following and input grounding. It ships as a 4GB Q4_K_M build plus BF16 weights under OpenMDW-1.1. NOT FILED: Tau2-Bench (55.10 BF16 / 52.32 Q4; the card links the aggregate 'core' board, while the corpus has per-domain tau2 columns), and MultiChallenge, RoleBench, RoleMRC, EQ-Bench v3, Brevity, When2Call, ToolSandbox, IHEval, AgentIF, StructEval-T, InverseIFEval, RULER (64K), LongMemEval, LongBench v2, SysBench, GaRAGe, RAGTruth and RelyToolBench, which have no corpus column.
